# Update Pumpkin Market Listing

Use this action to update metadata on a Pumpkin Market listing that already exists. Provide the
metadata in a JSON file, through direct inputs, or both. This action only changes listing metadata; it
doesn't read `info.ts`, build or upload a WASM file, create listings, or upload screenshots.

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [action guide](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/actions/update-pumpkin-market-listing/docs/) and [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/actions/update-pumpkin-market-listing/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

Add a step like this to your workflow. Store the Market API token as a GitHub secret and make
sure it can update listings:

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/actions/update-pumpkin-market-listing@update-pumpkin-market-listing-v0.0.3
    with:
      plugin-id: ${{ vars.PUMPKIN_MARKET_PLUGIN_ID }}
      metadata-file: .github/market-metadata.json
      api-token: ${{ secrets.MARKET_API_TOKEN }}
```

The example pins this action to its current Release Please tag. Action releases are independent
of plugin releases and other actions.

## Metadata sources

Choose the existing listing with exactly one of `plugin-name` or `plugin-id`. A name lookup reads up
to 10 pages of Market search results and must match the full listing name, ignoring case;
`plugin-id` accepts a numeric database ID or public ID.

The metadata file must be a JSON object that uses Market field names. You can provide direct inputs
on their own or layer them over the file; when both sources set the same field, the direct input wins.
This example sets the English description and the commands shown on the listing:

```json
{
  "translatedDescriptions": {
    "en-US": "A description shown on the Market listing"
  },
  "commands": [
    {
      "name": "hello",
      "aliases": ["hi"],
      "permission": "Example:command.hello",
      "description": { "en-US": "Say hello" },
      "display_order": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

The `description` input sets the `en-US` entry in `translatedDescriptions` and preserves other
locales. If both sources set the English description, the direct input wins.

By default, `update-mode` is `patch`: the action sends only the fields you provide and leaves the rest
of the listing unchanged. Empty direct inputs are ignored, so use the metadata file when you need to
send an explicit empty value. Set `update-mode` to `full` to require every listing field: `name`,
`category`, `sourceLink`, `youtubeVideoUrl`, `keywords`, `translatedDescriptions`, `isEarlyAccess`,
and `commands`.

## Inputs

<!-- action-inputs:start -->
| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-name` | No |  | Exact listing name; set this or plugin-id, but not both |
| `plugin-id` | No |  | Numeric database ID or public ID; set this or plugin-name, but not both |
| `metadata-file` | No |  | Path to a JSON object containing listing metadata; combine with direct inputs if needed |
| `display-name` | No |  | Listing display name (metadata field name) |
| `description` | No |  | Default en-US listing description; overrides that locale in translated-descriptions |
| `category` | No |  | Listing category |
| `source-link` | No |  | Listing source URL |
| `youtube-video-url` | No |  | Listing YouTube video URL |
| `keywords` | No |  | Comma-separated listing search keywords |
| `translated-descriptions` | No |  | JSON object mapping locale codes to listing descriptions |
| `is-early-access` | No |  | Whether the listing is marked as early access (true or false) |
| `commands` | No |  | JSON array of listing commands with names, optional aliases and permissions, localized descriptions, display order, and IDs |
| `update-mode` | No | `patch` | Metadata validation mode, patch or full; full requires all listing metadata fields |
| `api-token` | Yes |  | Market API token with listing update permission |
| `api-url` | No | `https://market.pumpkinmc.org` | Pumpkin Market base URL; must use https |
<!-- action-inputs:end -->

## Outputs

<!-- action-outputs:start -->
| Output | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `listing-id` | Resolved numeric Market database ID |
| `listing-name` | Canonical Market listing name |
| `status` | Operation result (success after a completed update) |
<!-- action-outputs:end -->

## Development

To change the action, add inputs and outputs to [`action.yml`](action.yml), implement the behavior
in `src/index.mjs`, and add tests in `src/*.test.mjs`. The input and output tables above are generated
from `action.yml`, so run `pnpm readme` after changing the action metadata. In the implementation, use
`getInput()` from `../../common/src/utils.mjs` to read GitHub inputs; it preserves hyphens in names such
as `plugin-name`. `action.yml` declares `src/index.mjs` as the Node runtime entry point, so no separate
build step is needed.
